name: litellm-cost-unpriced
description: Test 3 config window on LiteLLM v1.103.2: does a model with no price escape the budget? Needs test-claude-unpriced in config.yaml (Haiku with no input/output price) and the unpriced key (run-cost.sh). The priced model is refused once the key is over budget, and so is the unpriced one: LiteLLM skips budgets only for a model explicitly priced at 0 and treats a missing price as a cost (found 2026-10-18; the first run expected the opposite).
